name: The Vajraptor Canopy Sentinels
origin: feathered dromaeosaurs of the Mappa Mundi canopy
notes: Intelligent, territorial feathered dromaeosaurs with blue-and-red display plumage, flightless, who build hidden canopy nests. Fully raptor-shaped, they use wooden tools, signal to each other on bone flutes, wear fibre bands woven into their plumage, and fight alongside Mappa Mundi's human canopy-keepers in joint ambushes. Reclassified from the bestiary (`fauna_vajraptor`) to a people of allies by the owner's ruling of 29 September 2026.
